notes:
Fullobby 0.4.4-beta.1

Hell Let Loose: Vietnam support. If you have both Hell Let Loose and Hell
Let Loose: Vietnam installed, Fullobby now seeds whichever game your
networks need most at that moment. It checks this when it wakes up and when
you press Seed. The Seed button shows the game it will start underneath,
for example "(Hell Let Loose: Vietnam)". Wake-ups now only come from servers
in games you have installed, so no more "Seed now?" prompts for a game you
can't play.

Fullobby never closes a game without asking:
- Press Seed while the other game is open and it asks "Swap games?" first.
- An auto-seed that finds a game open says what Seed Now would close. If
  nobody answers, your game is left running and a notification tells you
  which game needs seeding.
- If you're playing one game when the other needs seeding, you get a
  notification with Swap and Not now buttons.

Other Unreal Engine games (Wardogs and the like) usually stop Hell Let Loose
from launching while they're open. Fullobby now checks for them before it
seeds or launches, and asks before closing one. You can also choose
Continue anyway.

Joining a network now takes an invite link from the network's staff instead
of a name and join code. Paste it during setup or in Settings → Networks, or
open the link in your browser and sign in with the account you use here. A
join code from before still works: choose "Have a join code instead?". And
when your network is paused, Fullobby now says so, instead of saying you're
outside the scheduled window.

This is a beta. Vietnam launching hasn't been tested on a real install yet.
If a Vietnam seed doesn't start, please send your log (Tools tab → View Logs).
